releaseNotes: Admin console 2.2.28: teachers who join with an invite code are now added to the teachers list automatically and stay connected until the head teacher disconnects them (new Connected pill and Disconnect button, plus a Sync connected teachers button); the Marks Grid now lists only the subjects a class actually takes and auto-switches invalid selections; report rows can no longer duplicate when subjects share a code; bold Editorial restyle for the crest, sidebar and highlight buttons. Teacher app 1.13.13 (unchanged).
